Must play equal/higher rank. 2=resets pile, 10=burns pile. Four-of-a-kind clears. Must draw to 3 from stock. Endgame plays face-up then blind face-down cards.

Vändtia is a Swedish shedding game whose name means "turning tens". Game historian Dan Glimne describes it as probably the ancestor of the international game Shithead, which spread via young backpackers in the late 20th century. It may have originated in Northern Sweden and is thought to date from the late 1970s; players consulted in 2000 recalled about twenty years of play. In Skåne (southern Sweden) it is often played under the name Skitgubbe, which can be confused with the classical Swedish three-hand game of the same name; the English name Shithead may derive from that Swedish word.
3 face-down + 3 face-up on top + 3 in hand. May swap hand/face-up before play.
